subject: Trial activation briefing & next steps (recap of today's discovery)
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Lena Morales <lena@zenithai.com>, Tom Weber <tom@zenithai.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Trial activation briefing & next steps (recap of today's discovery)

Hi Lena / Tom — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side so we all have the same expectations heading into the 30-day trial: 

Summary of pain & goals
- Pain: High inference cost and inconsistent latency on current stack; multiple models in use with brittle routing and no unified observability.
- Business goal: Improve LLM response latency to <350ms p95 for the document-assist workflow, and reduce per-inference cost by ~30% vs current hosted endpoints.
- Success metrics: p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and accuracy on your 400-case prompt set (see prompt_evals below).

Proposed trial scope (what we discussed)
- Duration: 30 calendar days, split into baseline (first 5 days) and optimization sprint (remaining 25 days).
- Workloads: 3 representative endpoints (search-assist, summarization, doc Q&A) using your anonymized sample set.
- Targets: p95 latency <350ms (test harness), 30% cost reduction target (through batching + quantization profile).

Prompt set & eval plan
- We'll run your 400-case prompt set through two epochs: baseline (current infra) and Redwood runtime (day 2 baseline capture).
- Evaluation dimensions: relevance (manual spot check), hallucination rate (automated heuristics + 20 curated checks), and latency/cost per token.
- Deliverables: evaluation report, recommended quantization profile, sample prompt tuning suggestions.

Owners & roles
- Redwood: Jordan Blake (Solutions Engineer) — technical lead for integration and eval harness. Monica Patel (Customer Success) — trial ops, acceptance criteria sign-off. Rachel Kim (Account Lead) — commercial and timeline owner.
- Zenith AI: Lena Morales — product owner; Tom Weber — engineering contact; procurement (procurement@zenithai.com) — contracting.

Access & setup steps (next actions)
1) Zenith provides a scoped S3 bucket with a small sample set + API access test keys (or allow Redwood to ingest a sanitized export). See access-checklist.csv attached. (Target: 2 business days)
2) Jordan will provide a short SDK snippet and a Postman collection for hitting the trial endpoints.
3) We will deploy a dedicated trial pool (non-production) on Redwood Dedicated for the trial. Estimated provisioning: 48–72 hours after access confirmed.
4) Security: we will complete the short security questionnaire you requested — Monica will own.

Timeline (proposed)
- Nov 26 (today): discovery recap and mutual action plan agreed.
- Nov 27–Nov 30: access provisioning and baseline capture.
- Dec 1–Dec 25: optimization sprint and prompt evals.
- Dec 26: delivery of final report & next-step recommendations.

Immediate asks for Zenith (can you confirm by EOD tomorrow?)
- Share contact for procurement and any PO/contract template.
- Grant read-only S3 access or drop sanitized sample into the shared bucket (access-checklist.csv attached).
- Confirm your main engineering contact for test-run coordination.

Attachments:
- trial-charter-zenithai.pdf (PDF, 48KB) — trial charter and acceptance criteria (draft)
- access-checklist.csv (CSV, 2KB) — minimal data/access checklist

Thanks — happy to hop on a short 15-min follow-up if useful.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189

1) Data & samples: we can provision a sanitized S3 bucket by tomorrow morning. Will that format (CSV + JSONL) work for Jordan's harness?
2) Security: we need to validate credentialing flow — can you confirm whether you'll need access to our VPC, or will the trial run through a public endpoint with token-based auth?

Also, can you share the evaluation template you referenced so our product team can review the metric definitions?

I'll confirm the engineering contact (probably Tom) and let you know by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
